gloss.en: new: recently made or begun; standard Chinese translation 新的
gloss.zh-Hans: 新的（标准翻译）；牛为文化候选，不是译词

meaning.en: new means 新的; 牛 means cattle/ox/cow according to context. Direct lexical-semantic equivalence: No / unsupported. The proposed bridge is cultural and indirect.
meaning.zh-Hans: new 的常规译义是新的；牛的基本词义属 cattle／ox／cow 类，依语境区分。直接词义等同：No／unsupported。这里的意义桥梁是间接文化联想。

rationale.en: Original Author Cultural-Temporal Mapping Hypothesis: 牛 → 丑牛 → unfolding nocturnal cycle → renewal/new. “子不代表新” is the author’s mapping choice, not a dictionary definition or a denial of 子-related day boundaries.
rationale.zh-Hans: 作者原创文化—时间映射假说：牛 → 丑牛 → 夜间周期展开 → renewal／new。“子不代表新”是作者本条的映射选择，不是辞书义，也不否认日界与子时的关系。

summary.en: English new continues Middle English newe/new/nywe and Old English nīowe/nīewe/nēowe. Merriam-Webster traces these through Germanic *neuja- to Indo-European *neu̯i̯o-, derived from *neu̯o-. French nouveau continues Latin novellus, a derivative of novus. The Latin base and English word belong to an independently documented Indo-European family; neither is derived from Chinese 牛.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 new 承接中古英语 newe／new／nywe 和古英语 nīowe／nīewe／nēowe；Merriam-Webster 上溯至日耳曼语拟构 *neuja- 及印欧语拟构 *neu̯i̯o-、*neu̯o-。法语 nouveau 来自拉丁语 novellus，后者由 novus 派生。拉丁语基础词与英语词的印欧词族关系有独立辞书依据；二者均不据此与牛建立历史关系。

claim.en: English new has an independent Germanic / Indo-European history.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 new 有独立的日耳曼语／印欧语历史。

claim.en: French nouveau derives from Latin novellus, from novus; a Latin derivative, not a borrowing from English new.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 nouveau 源于拉丁语 novellus，后者由 novus 派生；不是借自英语 new。

summary.en: Surface similarity: moderate for UK /njuː/, limited-to-moderate for US /nuː/; qualitative editorial assessment, not a measured distance. Both share /n/. UK /j/ resembles the Mandarin medial; US lacks it. English /uː/ differs from the Mandarin iou rime and its vowel movement. Mandarin rising lexical tone has no lexical-tone counterpart in English.
summary.zh-Hans: 表面音近：UK /njuː/ 评为中等，US /nuː/ 评为有限至中等；这是定性编辑评估，不是测量分数。共同点是 /n/；英式 /j/ 与普通话介音近似，美式参考读音没有该音。英语 /uː/ 与普通话 iou 韵母及其元音运动不同；普通话阳平也没有英语词汇声调对应。

claim.en: Documented context: 子–鼠 and 丑–牛; conventionally 子 23:00–01:00 and 丑 01:00–03:00. A mediated Bintuilu passage distinguishes the earlier and later parts of 子 across days and disputes treating the start of 子 as an automatic date change. This is evidence of a historical discussion, not a universal chronology.
claim.zh-Hans: 已核验的文化背景：子—鼠、丑—牛；通行换算子时 23:00–01:00、丑时 01:00–03:00。《宾退录》平台转录区分子时前后部分的日期归属，并辨析是否一入子时就换日；这说明存在历史辨析，不能据此宣布历代统一制度。

segments.onset: English /n/ and Mandarin n: shared nasal onset
segments.glide: UK /j/ ~ Mandarin i medial; absent in Cambridge US /nuː/
segments.nucleus: English /uː/ versus Mandarin iou; descriptive [njoʊ̯˧˥] here normalizes 汉典 niou˧˥, not a narrow measured IPA transcription
segments.coda: No consonantal coda; Mandarin has a closing vocalic movement
segments.tone: Mandarin 阳平, conventionally 35; English has intonation but no corresponding lexical tone

supporting_cases: One authored pair: new → 牛; documented cultural context only
counterexamples: 牛 has no supported standard NEW sense in the consulted lexical entry; print normative entry verification remains pending.
Independent English etymology; modern resemblance may be accidental.
Yod-dropping / accent selection changes the comparison.
Mandarin iou rime and rising tone are unmatched; spelling is not sound.
The zodiac-to-renewal bridge is authored; cultural facts do not prove cognacy.
Selecting one attractive pair invites selection bias; English new and French nouveau are not independent etymological replications.

testability.en: Pre-register auditory judgments for both English accents and Mandarin; compare matched random pairs, new→新 semantic control, culture-informed versus uninformed listeners, and culturally unrelated sound matches. Test memory benefit separately from sound distance. Deduplicate etymological families; no single-case generalization.
testability.zh-Hans: 预注册两种英语参考口音与普通话的听辨；设置匹配随机词对、new→新语义对照、知晓／不知晓文化背景的听者，以及无文化联系的音近对照。记忆收益与音系距离分别测试，词源家族去重；不从单例归纳规律。

proposition.en: Build bridges between languages, toward an age of spaceflight.
proposition.zh-Hans: 架起语言之间的桥梁，面向未来的宇航时代。

text.en: Build bridges between languages, toward a future age of spaceflight. When English or French reaches the ear, I imagine Collanguage turning the phrase into Chinese music, its notes rising and falling. Language Book explores this hope through language and culture. In my vineyard, manna flowers bloom.
text.zh-Hans: 架起语言之间的桥梁，让我们面向未来的宇航时代。当英语或法语传来，我想象借助 Collanguage 的规则与想象，把语句转成高低错落、如音乐般的汉语，走向美好的交流。考虑文化的因素，以汉语拼音探索跨语系的语言，是 Language Book 的追寻。在我的葡萄园，玛娜花盛开。

evidence_boundary.en: A literary aspiration, not a claim that automatic translation or a language law has been validated. The speculative names in the original note are not evidence for etymology or historical relation.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 文学愿景不意味着自动翻译能力或语言规律已获验证；原始笔记的推想不构成词源或历史关系证据。

claim.en: A mediated Ming text narrates Shennong / Yandi with an ox head and human body.
claim.zh-Hans: 明代文献的平台转录有炎帝神农人身牛首叙述。

cultural_associations.boundary: Narrative tradition only; no linguistic relation to NEW
